offer.title: Trip insurance
offer.note: Optional insurance that protects the vehicle throughout your trip.

dialog.deductibleCaption: The most the renter pays per incident
dialog.noticeBody: The renter bears a deductible of up to {amount} per incident for losses covered by the policy. If something happens, keep the scene as it is and call the {provider} hotline right away for a quick assessment.
dialog.noticeBodyNoDeductible: This product has no deductible. If something happens, keep the scene as it is and call the {provider} hotline right away for a quick assessment.

certificate.title: Insurance certificate
certificate.testNote: Test certificate - it provides no insurance cover.

note.pending_issue: The certificate is issued at vehicle handover.
note.issuing: XePrime is issuing the certificate - this usually takes a few minutes.
note.failed: Issuance failed - XePrime is handling it. You don't need to do anything.
note.refunded: The trip was cancelled before handover - the insurance premium has been refunded.

meta.title: Vehicle damage insurance benefits
meta.description: MIC per-trip vehicle damage insurance for self-drive cars on XePrime: benefits, deductible, who bears it and how to report an incident.

hero.title: Vehicle damage insurance benefits
hero.lead: MIC per-trip vehicle damage insurance for self-drive cars. Each owner chooses Required or Optional for their cars; the premium depends on the car value and rental days.

deductible.heading: Who bears the deductible
deductible.body: When there is a loss, the renter bears the per-incident deductible stated on the insurance certificate; the insurer pays the rest under MIC's rules.

scope.title: Covered cars and trips
scope.desc: Self-drive cars, trips of up to 30 days. Motorbikes, with-driver trips and long-term rentals are not covered by this insurance yet.

coverage.title: Coverage period
coverage.desc: From the owner's handover (plus 5 minutes) to the return time on the booking. The certificate shows in your trip once issued.

cancel.title: Cancellations
cancel.desc: Cancelling before pickup refunds 100% of what you paid for insurance, because the policy is only issued when the owner hands the car over.

unissued.title: If no certificate is issued
unissued.desc: If the certificate has still not been issued by the return time, XePrime automatically refunds everything you paid for insurance to your points wallet.

safety.title: Stay safe and keep the scene
safety.desc: Move people and the car to safety, and take photos of the scene and related documents.

hotline.title: Call the insurance hotline
hotline.desc: Report the incident to MIC via the hotline on the certificate, quoting the certificate number from your trip.

owner.title: Tell the owner
owner.desc: Message the owner in your trip to coordinate the assessment and repairs as MIC instructs.
